selected_evidence.summary: Shows the daily policy, the 02:00 daily periodic schedule, active crond, and successful policy parsing before and after restart.
Live rotation reports rotateCount 7, creates app.log-20260902.gz, and verifies the compressed archive and retained data.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: The active log inode remained 65543 across copytruncate, while data written before rotation entered the archive and data written afterward entered the active log through the same open descriptor.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID 6ef8b681-5c6d-41b6-b198-95dd26b73844, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID d93dc276-e5fd-47e5-bfab-0c4985e18b3f, and recovered scheduler, policy, archive, rotation state, and active-log data.

	. /etc/conf.d/logrotate
fi

if [ -x /usr/bin/cpulimit ] && [ -n "$CPULIMIT" ]; then
	_cpulimit="/usr/bin/cpulimit --limit=$CPULIMIT"

$_cpulimit /usr/sbin/logrotate /etc/logrotate.conf
